=== Day 1: the town meeting ===
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Rumormonger."
Lian: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Jory and Greta is Unrequited, and walks out at night for love."  [case board: #11, #12]
Greta: "That's a long silence. Someone has to speak first, and I'll wager it's me."
Greta: "I've got my own reason to suspect Odette, and no, I'm not laying it out for the Demon yet."  [case board: #13]
Odette: "Such a hush! Someone must take the stage, and I don't mind if it's me."
Odette: "Are we doing public confessions tonight? Let's get mine over with: I am the Clerk."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Greta and Isolde is the Gravedigger."
Odette: "From my window, I saw Kiran out in the street the night before you arrived."  [case board: #14, #15, #16]
Kiran: "Nobody's playing a card? Then I'll lead."
Kiran: "If we're comparing notes, friends, Lian looks shaky to me. Their Rumormonger report doesn't fit the facts as I know them."  [case board: #17]
Jory: "Is nobody going to say anything? All right, me then!"
Jory: "All right, listen up, everyone! Putting it out there right now: I am the Surveyor!"
Jory: "The night before you arrived, I learned that all the folk living on the Docks share the same alignment."  [case board: #18, #19]
